manaNeeded: {3} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{R}{G}{W}{W}.
description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}{G}{W}{W}.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}{G}{W}{W}.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Emancipation Angel by paying {1}{W}{W}.
When Emancipation Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and Zacama from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{R}{G}{W}{W}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may use that mana to activate Zacama's other abilities.
